 Order
1. The applicant/accused seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 437/2024 of PS Karol Bagh for offences under Section 363/376(2)(n)/328/377/506/509 IPC read with Sections 4/6 POCSO Act.
2. After addressing partly, learned counsel for the accused/applicant seeks permission to withdraw this bail application.
3. Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
